report_all_anti_patterns: run report_all_anti_patterns on a PyTorch profiler to detect performance anti-patterns and generate a TorchTidy report
review_extra_cuda_copy_pattern: review the ExtraCUDACopyPattern class that detects filling a CPU tensor and immediately moving it to GPU
review_fp32_matmul_pattern: review the FP32MatMulPattern class that detects FP32 matrix multiplications on TF32-capable GPUs
review_matmul_dim_fp16_pattern: review the MatMulDimInFP16Pattern class that detects misaligned FP16 matrix multiplication dimensions
review_optimizer_single_tensor_pattern: review the OptimizerSingleTensorPattern class that detects single-tensor optimizer usage and recommends foreach=True
